newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - BT active after MCI merger plan.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - BT active after MCI merger plan.

text.p: British Telecom was the focus of interest in the options market on Monday, following the company's Sunday confirmation of its $20 billion merger with MCI Communications of the U.S.

Traders said some 4,500 lots had traded by 1500 GMT, with very little activity elsewhere in the options market. BSkyB was the next most active at 638 lots. "BT has been the only stock that has traded in any volume," said one.
Activity in BT options was widely spread, the most active calls being the November 360 and November 390 contracts. Most active puts were the November 360 and February 390 contracts.
The underlying stock was up 20-1/2p at 371-1/2 by 1524 GMT in heavy trading of 70.7 million shares.
